identicalBranches.text: Every branch of this conditional does the same thing, so its condition chooses nothing: the code runs the same way [[outcome]]. Usually one branch was meant to differ and a copy was never edited ([[example]]). Write the branch that was meant, or, if both really are the same, drop the conditional and keep one copy.
